brand.name: GuardHub
brand.tagline: Website security checks in plain language.

common.footer: You get this message because alerts are on for your GuardHub account. You can change this under Account → Notifications.

change.subject: GuardHub: security changes on {project}
change.intro: Our latest scan of {target} found changes since the previous scan.

fixed.subject: GuardHub: issues fixed on {project}
fixed.intro: Good news: the latest scan of {target} shows that issues were fixed.
fixed.heading: Fixed

paused.subject: GuardHub: monitoring paused for {project}
paused.intro: We paused the scheduled scans of {target}.
paused.reason: We could no longer find your ownership proof (the verification file, the meta tag or the DNS record). We only scan websites whose owner has proven they control them.
paused.action: To turn monitoring back on, publish the proof again, verify the project, and then choose a scan frequency again.

test.subject: GuardHub: test notification
test.intro: This is a test message. Your GuardHub alerts will arrive here.
test.detail: We only send alerts when something changes: new issues, issues that came back, or issues that were fixed.

opsAlert.subject: [GuardHub] Alert: {label}
opsAlert.body: {label}: {value} (threshold {threshold}). Open the alert in the admin console:
